author: tomaj2
content:
Hi everyone! We've released ethlambda v1.0.0, LambdaClass's consensus client written in Rust.

Originally built for Lean Ethereum, ethlambda now has full beacon chain support, including Gloas. We're running it on mainnet, Sepolia, Hoodi and Platåberget, with validators on Sepolia and Hoodi. Our Sepolia validators completed the Glamsterdam transition without issues.

We're continuing to improve performance, expand validator client and Beacon API coverage, and participate in Hegotá interoperability devnets. Alongside that, we're working to bring our experience with Lean Ethereum's post-quantum cryptography to the beacon chain.

We'd appreciate feedback from other client teams and anyone interested in testing it!

- Announcement: https://blog.lambdaclass.com/ethlambda-a-beacon-chain-client-for-post-quantum-ethereum/
- Code and setup instructions: https://github.com/lambdaclass/ethlambda
- Live node metrics: https://metrics.ethlambda.xyz
